title: The rail lists every workspace destination
preconditions: Signed in to the approval console at http://localhost:3000
The console has finished its first load, so the rail is painted

steps.expect: the workspace rail and its support rail are visible

expected: The rail renders eleven buttons, each carrying its own hook: nav-board, nav-runs, nav-inbox, nav-knowledge, nav-workflows, nav-approvals, nav-chat, nav-observability, nav-docs, nav-settings and nav-account. Every button shows a visible label next to its icon.

title: Selecting Approvals opens the approvals panel
preconditions: Signed in to the approval console at http://localhost:3000
At least one pending approval exists in the tenant

steps.expect: the button becomes the active rail item
the button carries class active and aria-pressed true
a panel whose heading is Approvals

expected: After the click, [data-qa="nav-approvals"] carries the class active, and the panel area shows the approvals list under the heading Approvals. The other rail buttons no longer carry active.

title: An empty start card names the missing fields and disables Start
preconditions: Signed in to the approval console at http://localhost:3000
A start card is open for a workflow with storyKey and scope required

steps.expect: the card names the workflow and the ticket
the note reads Needs: Story key, Feature or flow

expected: With both required fields empty, [data-qa="start-missing"] reads Needs: Story key, Feature or flow and [data-qa="start-confirm"] is disabled.

title: Filling the required start fields enables Start
preconditions: Signed in to the approval console at http://localhost:3000
A start card for the qa workflow is open with both fields empty

steps.expect: the field holds a sentence of scope text
the button is enabled and reads Start run

expected: Once both required fields hold a value, no element matches [data-qa="start-missing"] and [data-qa="start-confirm"] is enabled and reads Start run.

title: Dismiss closes the start card without starting a run
preconditions: Signed in to the approval console at http://localhost:3000
A start card is open with both required fields filled

steps.expect: the runs list still shows the same number of runs

expected: Clicking [data-qa="start-dismiss"] removes the card: no element matches [data-qa="start-card"], and [data-qa="nav-runs"] lists the same number of runs as it did before the click.

title: The first checkpoint disables Back and offers Proceed
preconditions: Signed in to the approval console at http://localhost:3000
A run is open at its first checkpoint, with no earlier step to return to

steps.expect: the button is enabled and carries the step's proceed label

expected: At the first checkpoint [data-qa="decision-back"] is disabled, [data-qa="decision-proceed"] is enabled with the step's proceed label, and [data-qa="decision-edit"], [data-qa="decision-regenerate"] and [data-qa="decision-abort"] are present in the decision row.
